groupings.title: Image Generation
groupings.description: Generate images from text prompts using local, API-key-free, headless backends (GPT via Codex, Gemini via Antigravity).

groupings.title: Video
groupings.description: Watch and understand any video, from a clip to a full film: every shot indexed and seen once in timestamped grids (~7x cheaper than frame-by-frame), plus a transcript. Also culls footage.
